svg.aria-label: Agent Platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
svg.title: Agent Platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
svg.text: Agent Platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

Interactive cloud workspaces (Claude Code web terminal) + headless agent kernels behind one portal · schedules, channels, memory and evals through one governed pipeline · fixed-EIP egress to an IP-allow-listed LLM gateway

① portal → ② REST /api/v1 → ③ InvokeAgentRuntime (warmup) → ④ VPC egress → ⑤ LLM gateway · EventBridge Scheduler → Lambda fires schedules (retries + DLQ) · channel webhooks enter the same governed pipeline · AgentCore Memory = cross-session recall · workspace + conversation resume from S3
